planner_redesign_basis: HubPlanner 2026-10-08 Candidate2 stable systemd identity and complete preflight test
decision: whether one cache-managed full-session Candidate 2 sort reaches saved effective nblocks=1 and becomes eligible for downstream comparison against REF and A
cheapest_adequate_test: before any production start, execute the actual full preflight main under temporary realistic inactive-to-active user services and synthetic metadata through valid receipt serialization plus changed path/argv/ignore-errors negatives; only after GO is one fresh full-session run adequate for the memory/science decision
completion_condition: one fresh managed imec0 sort plus existing curation/QC reaches a terminal receipt with saved effective nblocks=1, or one preserved terminal failure; never retry automatically

repair_delta.only_executable_change: candidate2_cache_managed_preflight.py obtains each loaded unit object with org.freedesktop.systemd1.Manager.GetUnit and reads typed Service.ExecStart/ExecStartPre a(sasbttttuii), authorizing only exact executable path, argv array and ignore_errors per command with exact order/cardinality/argument boundaries; it also preserves the output Path by naming systemctl stdout systemctl_output
repair_delta.reason: v7 proved raw systemctl ExecStart strings include changing runtime annotations, while the same preflight also overwrote its output Path with systemctl stdout before receipt parent creation
repair_delta.required_regression: actual full preflight main under realistic dummy user-service lifecycle accepts inactive-to-active runtime-only changes, writes a valid complete receipt, rejects changed executable path/argv/ignore_errors, and separately retains GPU self/external/low-memory/query/malformed cases
repair_delta.accepted_unchanged_dependency: v5 parser forwarding, v7 exact-self GPU classification, v7 final runner late-arrival gates, sorter/monitor/science, and cache-managed three-operation mode remain accepted and unchanged
repair_delta.runner_contract_join: retain the unchanged runner-bound scientific parent hash 1a68ab33... and bind v6 separately as the operational predecessor; an actual isolated runner subprocess must pass this guard and stop only on a deliberately missing preflight receipt
repair_delta.late_arrival_regression: actual rescue-production interpreter fixture first passes a clean runner gate, then verifies that a newly arrived external GPU PID and a newly arrived competing sorter each fail the final runner gate
repair_delta.systemd_identity_regression: typed fixtures accept empty command arrays as a valid typed value, reject malformed signatures/rows/query failure, and preserve exact command order, cardinality, argument boundaries and flags
repair_delta.unchanged: sorter, monitor implementation/classification, science parameters, input, cache-managed three-operation mode, GPU free-memory threshold, lifecycle and absence of hard memory/runtime caps

attempt.derivation_rule: output_root is the single attempt root; results_dir must equal output_root/kilosort4 and partial_results_dir must equal results_dir+'.partial'; the executor must recompute and compare all three before any recording open
attempt.freshness: all output, partial, launch, log, receipt and service identities must be absent before installation/start

input.validation_policy: perform the existing full accepted-content validation once, with exact-target 8 MiB completed ranges advised POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED; do not omit identity validation and do not perform an unmanaged duplicate hash

science_binding.arm_difference: relative to REF, only do_correction changes false->true; both requested nblocks=1 but REF resolves to effective 0 and Candidate2 must resolve to effective 1
science_binding.full_parameter_rule: the complete candidate sorter parameter dictionary must equal the saved Candidate2 request byte-for-byte after JSON-safe normalization; the listed subset is not a replacement for the full equality gate

required_operations: full-content validator advises each completed 8 MiB exact-target range POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED
immediately before sort, issue whole-file POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED, wait 5 seconds, record before/after MemAvailable and PSI, and reapply the launch gates
Kilosort exact-target reader uses one grow-as-needed reusable preadv buffer and advises each completed input batch range POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED after device copy

source_and_environment.source_closure_rule: exact 31-member source inventory is frozen by SOURCE_MANIFEST.json; isolated bootstrap rejects missing, extra, symlink, bytecode, or changed members before project import
source_and_environment.binding_policy: post-review AUTHORIZATION.json must bind exact contract, source manifest and installed service hashes; preflight and bootstrap both verify it

resource_conditions.gpu_required: one idle NVIDIA RTX A5000-equivalent CUDA device with no competing compute process
resource_conditions.process_required: no competing full sort, materialization, large recording hash, or memory-intensive project service
resource_conditions.oomd_required: capture current user-slice and proposed-unit oomd policy; no active oomd event or material pressure before start
resource_conditions.inode_required: record free inodes and require enough for projected outputs; no fixed inode count is inferred from stale state
resource_conditions.runtime_estimate: approximately 6-10 hours for sort plus existing downstream; observational planning range, not a stop or timeout

working_set_model.preprocessing_source_visible_gpu_live_en: less than approximately 1.5 GiB before backend workspaces; not an enforced cap
working_set_model.interpretation: historical values and source accounting guide the 160 GiB availability condition; they are not hard caps or guaranteed peaks

telemetry.scope: reuse the existing reviewed external systemd/cgroup telemetry pattern at 10 seconds; the separately managed monitor survives target failure and records terminal reconciliation
telemetry.failure_policy: telemetry startup and first fresh sample remain prelaunch gates; target BindsTo monitor liveness. Later missing monitor terminal is a documented observability failure and is never success; merged or unknown causes remain failed or unresolved without inferred attribution.

launch_and_lifecycle.manager: persistent systemd --user oneshot target service plus separate external simple monitor service
launch_and_lifecycle.effective_timeout_requirement: installed service TimeoutStartUSec must resolve to infinity before start; omission or any finite value is rejected because the host manager default is finite
launch_and_lifecycle.dummy_survival_check: reuse the already verified systemd user-service launch method; record its prior survival receipt in the enabled derivative
launch_and_lifecycle.checkpoint_truth: Kilosort has no within-sort checkpoint; interruption restarts from the beginning in another separately reviewed fresh namespace
launch_and_lifecycle.terminal_receipt: monitor labels describe service state only and may merge or leave failure causes unresolved. Missing monitor terminal is permitted only as documented observability failure. Any failed, missing or inconsistent completion evidence is incomplete, failed or unresolved, never successful.

external_final_reconciliation.owner: H5/coordinator on terminal notification or next resumption; no always-running reconciler
required_evidence: manager loaded properties and exact real ExecStart invocation
manager InvocationID, Result, ExecMainCode and ExecMainStatus
JOB receipt proving real child command rather than verify-only and zero child exit
valid sorter, curation and all requested QC output receipts/artifacts
external_final_reconciliation.full_completion_rule: claim candidate2 sort-and-QC completion only when all required evidence matches the exact source, input, attempt and invocation; manager and child exits are zero; status stage is candidate2_sort_and_qc_complete_comparison_pending; effective_nblocks is 1; and sort, curation and QC outputs are valid
external_final_reconciliation.partial_success_rule: if sorting completed but later curation or QC failed, preserve and report sort success separately from downstream failure; never claim complete comparison
external_final_reconciliation.scientific_rule: scientific benefit remains a separate reviewed analysis and is never inferred from process status

stop_conditions: normal completion of sort, curation and QC
any provenance, path-derivation, environment, source-hash, cache-mode or effective-setting mismatch
failure of any prelaunch disk, memory, PSI, GPU, oomd or process-conflict condition
any nonzero managed-job exit, sorter exception or oomd action
unexpected competing full sort or memory-intensive recording job

preserved_failures.kind: source-only recovery and rejected sole-env proposal history
v6 pre-read GPU self-registration preflight failure
v7 pre-read runtime-decorated ExecStart authorization failure

authorization_and_release.hub_conditional_release: one fresh full Candidate2 run is authorized after the exact executable/contract/service join receives focused bound GO and fresh exact input/source/GPU/host/process/output reconciliation passes
authorization_and_release.release_requirement: install/start only after focused review of typed systemd identity, Path-shadow repair, actual full-preflight receipt path and deployed bindings yields GO and creates exact typed AUTHORIZATION.json; fresh reconciliation must pass; no further H1, planner or human release round is required
